decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - Full details of the thermal insulation for the tile hung wall to demonstrate their effect on the character and appearance of the listed building shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of the insulation hereby permitted and the development shall be carried out in complete accordance with the detail so approved.
Condition : 5 - The roof tiles should be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 4 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 6 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution, unless otherwise specified in the application hereby approved.
description: Removal of roof covering and installation of insulation to roof and replacement of roof finish. Removal of tile hanging to overhanging room above front door, installation of insulation and replacement tile hanging.Replacement of casement window of existing dormer. Internal alterations to enable installation of conservation rooflight. (Listed Building Works).
